title: Dreamcatcher
description: Ambient looper, glitch delay with grains and pitch shifting, and reverb, free or in time with a tempo. 8 presets, Bluetooth MIDI, USB audio. Source: github.com/OpenGP5/Dreamcatcher.

title: NAM Loader
description: Plays NAM A2 captures at 48 kHz with an input and output level, a noise gate and EQ each, and any of 12 cab IRs; USB audio. 30 slots, filled from the Tones page.
